senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced. wds.) recklessness, overweening. Pesik. Ekha, p. 121ᵇ אחד ראה אותה בשלותה ואחד ראה אותה בפַחְזָהּ וכ׳ one saw her in her happiness, one in her recklessness (sin), and one in her disgrace. Ib. ישעיה ראה אותן בפַחְזָן Isaiah saw them (Israel) in their wantonness (ref. to Is. I, 21).
